title: Rogue Valley Pottery Supply Firing Service
source_quote: Rogue Valley Pottery Supply is happy to offer firing services for your projects.
evidence_sentence: The shop's kiln firing page offers test, half, and full load firings at set prices without specifying kiln type.
evidence_quote: Rogue Valley Pottery Supply is happy to offer firing services for your projects. The links below will provide more detailed firing instructions and a contact form for submitting a firing time.
summary: Bring or ship finished work for firing. Test load $10, half load $25, full load $50. Contact the shop to schedule.
cost_text: Test firing $10, Half Load $25, Full Load $50
how_to_join: Contact the shop at 541-255-3499 or fill out a form
